package.description: Private dictation and meeting notes for Windows. Talk and it types. Take meeting minutes with no bot, and no audio ever leaves your computer.

en-US.description: Private dictation and meeting notes for Windows. Talk and it types. Take meeting minutes with no bot, and no audio ever leaves your computer.
en-US.longDescription:
Softspoken is a private dictation app and meeting notetaker for Windows that transcribes on your own computer. Hold a key in any app, say what you mean, and clean text lands at your cursor, about three times faster than typing. Take the minutes in a boardroom or on a Zoom or Teams call with no bot in the room, and get who said what, what was decided, and who owes what by when.

The audio never leaves your computer. Recording and transcription run on your own machine, and by default the audio is deleted once the notes are written. The optional AI layer, for cleaning up dictation and writing meeting summaries, runs in Australia, or on your own Anthropic or AWS key on a paid plan, or you can turn AI off entirely.

- Dictation in any app: speak instead of typing, anywhere on your PC.
- Meetings without a bot: in person or on Teams and Zoom, nothing joins the call.
- Private by design: on-device transcription, and your audio is never uploaded.
- Organised by client and by person: a folder for each client, a page for each person, and actions with an owner and a due date.
- Keep a client off AI: one switch on a folder, and its meetings are never sent to any AI model.
- Import what you already have: recordings are transcribed on your computer, and Teams or Zoom transcripts come in as they are.
- AI your way: Softspoken AI in Australia, your own Anthropic or AWS key, or no AI at all.
- Your meetings work for you: ask questions across everything you have recorded, see what you owe and what you are waiting on, and connect your library to AI tools.

The app is free. Optional Softspoken AI and Pro features are available separately.
en-US.name: Softspoken
